entry.title: How to avoid food overproduction in an era of shortages
entry.summary: Overproduction can be costly, tying up a company's capital and causing significant waste. In a time when food shortages are common, companies are frequently building up stores as a buffer, increasing the risk of overproduction. In order to avoid this, companies must plan smarter and aim to make more accurate forecasts with the tools available to them.
